This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Security Engineer based in Brazil.

As a Senior Security Engineer, you will play a key role in strengthening cybersecurity operations and protecting a growing technology ecosystem. Acting as the technical reference for the Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT), you will lead complex security incidents, coordinate crisis response activities, and drive continuous improvements in incident management processes. You will work closely with engineering, IT, SRE, legal, compliance, and other stakeholders to identify threats, minimize risks, and ensure effective remediation. Beyond incident response, you will contribute to Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), Security Operations Center (SOC) oversight, and Purple Team initiatives. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic thinking and cross-functional leadership. You will help build a more mature security posture while supporting innovative technology platforms and large-scale digital services.

lists.content:
Lead the organization's incident response strategy and strengthen its cybersecurity operations by coordinating technical teams, improving detection capabilities, and ensuring effective management of security risks. You will oversee the full incident lifecycle, from identification and investigation to containment, recovery, and continuous improvement.

  • Lead the CSIRT incident response strategy and serve as the technical reference during security crises, coordinating incident response war rooms and collaborating with Engineering, SRE, and IT teams.

  • Manage incident containment, eradication, and recovery activities while maintaining clear and consistent communication with relevant stakeholders.

  • Identify, classify, investigate, and remediate security incidents, ensuring root cause analysis, permanent resolution, and proper preservation of digital evidence.

  • Develop and continuously improve incident response processes, including incident-specific playbooks, operational runbooks, tabletop exercises, and response performance metrics such as MTTD, MTTR, and SLAs.

  • Apply recognized frameworks and methodologies, including NIST and SANS, to standardize incident management and strengthen operational maturity.

  • Manage security and privacy incidents involving Brazil's LGPD requirements, coordinating impact assessments and corrective measures with governance, legal, and compliance teams.

  • Oversee SOC operations and manage relationships with external security service providers, ensuring effective detection, investigation, escalation, and incident response.

  • Improve detection rules, escalation criteria, automation, and operational processes while reducing false positives and strengthening SOC performance.

  • Connect offensive and defensive security activities, including penetration testing, Breach and Attack Simulation (BAS), and threat hunting, translating identified Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) into improved detection capabilities.

  • Coordinate Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) activities, monitoring emerging threats, brand mentions, suspicious domains, data leaks, phishing campaigns, and relevant threat actor behavior.

  • Analyze threat intelligence findings and distribute actionable insights to support proactive security measures and incident preparedness.

  • Collaborate with technical and corporate teams to assess cybersecurity risks and develop technical and executive reports that support informed decision-making.

    • Requirements:

    You are an experienced cybersecurity professional with a strong background in incident response and security operations. You combine broad technical knowledge with the ability to lead complex investigations, coordinate multidisciplinary teams, and communicate security risks effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable working across different technology environments and continuously improving security processes.

  • Solid professional experience leading security incident response activities within corporate environments, particularly CSIRT or SOC operations, from initial detection through investigation, resolution, and post-incident improvement.

  • Broad technical knowledge across endpoints, networks, identity management, SaaS, cloud infrastructure, and applications, with the autonomy to lead the resolution of different incident types.

  • Experience handling security incidents such as phishing, malware, ransomware, account compromise, data breaches, distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks, and digital fraud.

  • Strong ability to assess incident severity, prioritize response activities, and coordinate appropriate remediation efforts.

  • Experience analyzing network, system, application, and identity logs to identify suspicious activity and security anomalies.

  • Hands-on experience with SIEM solutions, including detection rule development, tuning, and optimization.

  • Understanding of incident response in cloud environments, particularly audit logs, identity and credential compromise, workloads, and containers.

  • Familiarity with security technologies and solutions such as EDR/XDR, SIEM, firewalls, IPS/IDS, WAF, CASB, DLP, ZTNA, MDM, VPN, and PAM.

  • Experience managing external security vendors and service providers, monitoring service quality, and driving continuous improvements in their deliverables.

  • Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including NIST SP 800-61, SANS, MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, particularly when explaining technical incidents, business risks, and potential impacts to non-technical audiences.

  • Ability to work collaboratively across technical and corporate functions while taking ownership of complex security challenges.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Practical knowledge of digital forensics, including evidence acquisition, preservation, chain of custody, and forensic analysis.

  • Advanced knowledge or hands-on experience in offensive security, including penetration testing, Red Team activities, Capture the Flag (CTF) exercises, or bug bounty programs.

  • Experience using offensive security findings and TTP analysis to improve defensive capabilities and detection strategies.

  • Experience managing security incidents with regulatory implications or external communication requirements.

  • Knowledge of security automation and orchestration solutions, including SOAR platforms and programming languages such as Python.

  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code security and CI/CD pipeline protection, including tools and technologies such as Terraform and GitHub.

  • Relevant professional certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GCFE, GNFA, GCTI, ECIH, OSCP, or equivalent qualifications.

    • Benefits:

  • Meal and/or food allowance through the Flash benefits platform.

  • SulAmérica medical and dental insurance.

  • Extended maternity and paternity leave.

  • Childcare assistance.

  • Wellhub partnership for health, fitness, and wellness activities.

  • Zenklub partnership for mental health and emotional well-being support.

  • Discounts on airline tickets.

  • Access to a partner pet health insurance plan.

  • Access to educational materials and learning resources for employees' children.

  • Inclusive working environment with equal opportunities for people with disabilities.

We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer with strong expertise in Snowflake and dbt, combined with practical knowledge of Finance and Procurement operations. In this role, you will design and maintain curated data models that turn complex financial information into reliable, analytics-ready datasets. Working closely with Finance, Procurement, and technical stakeholders, you will translate business requirements into scalable data solutions. You will also contribute to data quality, governance, and modeling standards across financial datasets. lists.content:
You will take ownership of developing and optimizing data models for Finance and Procurement, ensuring that business users can access consistent, trusted, and meaningful information. Your work will connect technical data engineering practices with real-world financial processes and reporting needs.

  • Design, develop, and maintain curated Finance and Procurement data models using Snowflake and dbt.

  • Work with financial data from enterprise applications such as NetSuite, Coupa, Brex, Workday Adaptive Planning, or equivalent platforms.

  • Model key financial business objects, including general ledger accounts, journal entries, invoices, purchase orders, vendors, expenses, budgets, and cost centers.

  • Collaborate with Finance, Procurement, and other business stakeholders to translate functional requirements into reliable, analytics-ready data models.

  • Build and optimize data transformation pipelines, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, quality, and performance.

  • Leverage Snowflake Semantic Views and Cortex Agents to support business-friendly data exploration, self-service analytics, and AI-powered insights.

  • Establish and promote best practices for data modeling, documentation, testing, and governance across Finance datasets.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong technical data engineering skills with a solid understanding of financial data structures and business processes. You should be comfortable working independently, engaging with nontechnical stakeholders, and translating complex business concepts into scalable data solutions.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake, SQL, and dbt, including dimensional modeling and the development of curated analytical data layers.

  • Proven experience building data models for Finance, Accounting, Procurement, or Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) use cases.

  • Understanding of financial data structures, relationships, and concepts such as general ledger (GL), accounts payable and receivable (AP/AR), budgeting, forecasting, procurement, and expense management.

  • Familiarity with data from financial applications such as NetSuite, Coupa, Brex, Workday Adaptive Planning, or equivalent enterprise systems. Direct experience with these specific tools is not mandatory.

  • Familiarity with Snowflake’s analytics and AI capabilities, particularly Semantic Views and Cortex Agents.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and nontechnical Finance stakeholders.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently design reliable, scalable financial data models.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Experience implementing Snowflake Semantic Views or developing AI-enabled analytics solutions using Cortex.

  • Understanding of financial reporting, reconciliation, and data governance requirements.

  • Experience integrating financial data from multiple enterprise systems into a unified analytics platform.

  • Experience supporting Finance transformation, reporting modernization, or self-service analytics initiatives.

    • Benefits:

  • Opportunity to work on Finance and Procurement analytics initiatives with meaningful business impact.

  • Exposure to Snowflake’s semantic and AI capabilities, including Cortex Agents.

  • Opportunity to contribute to modern data architecture, financial reporting, and AI-driven analytics solutions.

  • Evaluate existing business processes, identify improvement opportunities, and recommend solutions that increase efficiency and reduce redundancy.

  • Analyze business challenges and available data to identify root causes, assess alternatives, and propose effective solutions.

  • Influence stakeholders and work collaboratively to identify practical, acceptable solutions.

  • Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills, with the ability to understand complex business challenges and translate them into practical solutions.

  • Excellent requirements gathering, business process analysis, and documentation skills.

  • Experience developing user stories, test scripts, reports, and training documentation.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence decision-makers and collaborate across different teams.

  • Creative problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to identifying process improvements.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities efficiently and effectively in a dynamic environment.

  • Fluent Portuguese and English; Spanish is considered an advantage.

    • Benefits

  • Competitive compensation aligned with skills and experience.

  • Bonus opportunities.

  • Benefits designed to recognize and reward high-performing professionals.

  • Fully remote working arrangement in Brazil.

  • Opportunity to work with global teams and enterprise technology platforms.

  • Collaborative environment focused on innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth.

  • Opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects and solutions that improve client outcomes.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) – Platform based in Brazil.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Site Reliability Engineer to build and evolve an intelligent engineering platform that supports the entire software development organization. In this role, you will lead the development of an Agentic Engineering Platform, combining infrastructure automation, AI-powered agents, and developer experience to simplify complex engineering workflows. You will design scalable infrastructure, establish standardized development paths, and integrate observability and automation into the platform's core architecture. Working with Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform, Terraform, and emerging AI technologies, you will help transform infrastructure operations into intelligent, increasingly autonomous processes. You will collaborate closely with SRE, FinOps, and product engineering teams to improve reliability, efficiency, and cost management. This is a high-impact opportunity to shape an AI-first engineering culture and redefine how modern platform reliability is delivered.

lists.content:
• Ensure the reliability, availability, scalability, and performance of infrastructure components and the internal engineering platform.
  • Design, build, and continuously evolve the Agentic Engineering Platform, developing orchestration layers that understand developer intent, coordinate API executions, generate code, analyze data, and support AI-assisted troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain standardized Golden Paths for CI/CD, integrating AI agents into workflows covering service templates, code reviews, approvals, and pull request merges while enforcing defined engineering guardrails.
  • Reduce service onboarding and setup time through standardized templates, automation, and improved developer experience.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive monitoring, observability, and alerting solutions as foundational components of the engineering platform.
  • Consolidate metrics, logs, traces, events, and infrastructure costs into reliable data sources that support intelligent automation and informed technical decisions.
  • Evolve and maintain Kubernetes infrastructure on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), focusing on sustainability, standardization, scalability, and intelligent automation.
  • Establish and improve incident management processes using AI-assisted detection, diagnosis, troubleshooting, and remediation workflows.
  • Design, implement, and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, including intelligent code generation, validation, automated rollback, recovery, and operational remediation.
  • Define, monitor, and improve Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and error budgets for platform components, establishing practices that can be replicated across product teams.
  • Support critical system migrations, environment segregation, and the deprecation of legacy technologies.
  • Collaborate closely with SRE Partner, FinOps, and product engineering teams to integrate reliability, cost efficiency, and platform capabilities across the organization.
  • Drive the adoption of AI-first engineering practices, promoting automation, standardization, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

    • Requirements:

  • Strong professional experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly GKE, IAM, Pub/Sub, and BigQuery.
  • Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes and distributed systems architecture.
  • Solid experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), particularly Terraform.
  • Proficiency in observability tools and practices, including Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Thanos, OpenTelemetry, and Alertmanager.
  • Strong ability to analyze logs, metrics, traces, and performance issues across distributed systems.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Helm, and GitOps practices, particularly within GKE environments.
  • At least two years of professional software development experience using Go or Python in production environments, with an emphasis on building high-quality, maintainable platform solutions rather than relying exclusively on configuration.
  • Practical experience deploying and operating LLM-based agents in production, including tool usage within agentic loops, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and orchestration through Vertex AI, Anthropic, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience defining, monitoring, and managing SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets.
  • Hands-on experience with incident management, on-call rotations, troubleshooting, and post-incident reviews (post-mortems).
  • Strong data-driven and AI-first mindset, with the ability to leverage intelligence and automation to reduce manual effort and improve technical decision-making.
  • A platform-builder mindset, combining architectural thinking with hands-on development and implementation skills.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across SRE, FinOps, and product engineering teams.
  • Strong sense of ownership, proactive problem-solving abilities, and motivation to continuously improve platform reliability and developer productivity.

    • Nice to have:

  • Previous experience building internal developer platforms (IDPs), Golden Paths, or developer experience (DevEx) solutions.
  • Significant contributions to observability initiatives, toil reduction, or operational automation projects.
  • Experience working in multi-cloud environments or organizations operating large-scale, high-traffic systems.
  • Familiarity with declarative infrastructure management and advanced GitOps practices.
  • Experience designing intelligent automation workflows that combine AI agents with infrastructure operations.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote work model, with the flexibility to work from anywhere in Brazil.
  • Opportunity to build and shape an innovative Agentic Engineering Platform.
  • Exposure to advanced technologies, including AI agents, LLMs, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and distributed systems.
  • Opportunity to contribute to an AI-first engineering strategy and influence platform architecture across the organization.
  • High level of technical ownership and autonomy over strategic engineering initiatives.
  • Collaboration with experienced professionals across SRE, FinOps, infrastructure, and product engineering.
  • Continuous learning and professional development in a technically challenging environment.
  • Opportunity to work on large-scale systems supporting millions of users and extensive data infrastructure.
  • Inclusive and remote-first working environment.

  • Guide the venture through its early development stages, from discovery and validation to MVP launch, first paying customers, and subsequent scaling.

  • Experience in or close exposure to regulated consumer finance or insurance markets, such as consumer credit, fintech lending, insurtech, pensions, or personal financial management.

  • Comfort making product decisions in environments where legal and compliance stakeholders play an active role in shaping product strategy and execution.

  • Strong customer discovery and validation skills, including the ability to develop interview plans, test hypotheses, evaluate demand, and pivot or discontinue product directions based on evidence.

  • An AI-native mindset, with practical enthusiasm for using AI to increase team productivity and build intelligent, personalized product experiences rather than treating AI as an add-on feature.

  • Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, with the ability to combine qualitative research and data to prioritize opportunities, assess trade-offs, and define meaningful metrics in an early-stage business.

  • Ability to balance speed and innovation with rigorous attention to data privacy, responsible credit practices, regulatory requirements, and employer trust.

You will combine hands-on security testing, third-party vendor management, and AI-assisted security tools to strengthen application and product security. Working across web applications, APIs, cloud services, integrations, and AI-powered features, you will help protect critical systems and customer data. You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, compliance, and security teams to establish testing standards and drive effective remediation strategies. You will also oversee external security engagements, compliance evidence, and program performance metrics. This is a senior technical leadership opportunity offering broad ownership, strategic influence, and the chance to shape security practices in a rapidly evolving cloud and AI environment.

lists.content:
• Lead, plan, and execute penetration tests across web applications, APIs, cloud services, and integrations to identify and address critical vulnerabilities before product releases and in production environments.
  • Assess multi-tenant SaaS architectures, focusing on tenant isolation, cross-tenant data access, authorization boundaries, and protection of customer information.
  • Lead security testing of AI and machine learning features, including LLM-powered applications, APIs, and inference endpoints, identifying risks such as prompt injection, data or model leakage, insecure Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) implementations, and potential abuse scenarios.
  • Validate, reproduce, and assess security vulnerabilities using industry-standard methodologies, including CVSS, and provide engineering teams with clear, actionable remediation recommendations.
  • Retest implemented fixes and verify that vulnerabilities have been properly resolved before formally closing findings.
  • Develop penetration testing scripts, tools, and automation to improve testing coverage, consistency, and efficiency.
  • Evaluate AI-assisted and autonomous security testing solutions to enhance testing capabilities and support scalable security assessments.
  • Own the penetration testing schedule across the product release lifecycle, ensuring all products are appropriately tested before key milestones, from early access through general availability and continuous delivery.
  • Determine testing scope and frequency based on product risk, release requirements, and applicable compliance obligations.
  • Define rules of engagement, testing environments, scope, and access requirements for external penetration testing engagements.

  • Coordinate responsibilities between product teams, implementation partners, and external vendors to ensure testing readiness and successful execution.

  • Evaluate vendor performance and testing coverage, recommending improvements to methodologies, processes, or vendor partnerships when necessary.
  • Ensure penetration testing activities meet relevant compliance requirements, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and customer-specific contractual obligations.
  • Maintain penetration testing documentation, evidence, attestation letters, and executive summaries for auditors and customers.
  • Monitor vulnerability remediation against established service-level agreements (SLAs) and communicate progress, outstanding risks, and overall security posture to product, engineering, and security leadership.
  • Define and report program performance indicators, including testing coverage, on-time completion, vulnerability age, and SLA compliance.

  • Hands-on experience testing applications hosted on AWS, including familiarity with IAM, cloud security configurations, and multi-tenant architectures.
  • Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks and penetration testing requirements, particularly SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS.

  • Familiarity with performance testing, load testing, accessibility validation, visual regression, monitoring, and production observability.

lists.content:

  • Supplier Management: Identify, evaluate, and develop relationships with suppliers across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery schedules while monitoring supplier performance.

  • Purchasing and Supply Chain Coordination: Manage purchasing activities supporting production, warehouse, and installation operations. Resolve supplier-related quality, logistics, and delivery issues, and identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve procurement efficiency.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Project Management, Engineering, Estimating, Warehouse, and Installation teams to coordinate material requirements, engineering changes, substitutions, and procurement planning.

Working primarily with .NET and Microsoft Azure, this professional will define scalable architectures, establish engineering standards, and support key technical decisions. The role involves close collaboration with product and business stakeholders to translate requirements into reliable, high-performing applications. You will mentor developers, promote best practices, and strengthen code quality, security, and system performance. The successful candidate will also drive continuous improvement across development processes, tools, and workflows. This is an opportunity to shape technical direction and help a distributed engineering team deliver impactful cloud solutions.

lists.content:

  • Define and evolve software architecture, technical standards, and best practices across .NET and Microsoft Azure environments.

  • Participate in hands-on development, technical problem-solving, and key architectural decisions.

  • Conduct code reviews, promote clean and maintainable code, and ensure consistent engineering standards.

  • Mentor developers, encourage knowledge sharing, and support the team's technical growth.

  • Collaborate closely with product and business stakeholders to understand requirements and design effective technical solutions.

  • Ensure applications meet quality, performance, scalability, reliability, and security expectations.

  • Guide the design and implementation of cloud-native solutions, REST APIs, and microservices architectures.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across development processes, engineering tools, and delivery practices.

  • Support technical estimations, project planning, prioritization, and decision-making.

  • Promote effective use of Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern software engineering practices.

  • Strong professional experience developing and delivering production applications using .NET, particularly .NET Core and .NET 6 or later.

  • Previous experience as a Tech Lead, Technical Lead, or in a comparable technical leadership position.

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services, including App Services, Azure Functions, APIs, databases, and deployment pipelines.

  • Solid understanding of software architecture principles, including REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native design.

  • Practical experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and code review practices.

  • Proven ability to mentor developers, guide technical decisions, and establish effective engineering practices.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with product, business, and engineering teams.

  • Analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on delivering scalable, maintainable, and secure solutions.

  • Ability to balance strategic technical leadership with hands-on development and day-to-day team support.

    • Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience working with high-scale, high-availability applications and distributed systems.

  • Previous experience in fully remote environments and with geographically distributed development teams.

  • Knowledge of cloud security practices and application observability.

  • Microsoft or Azure certifications.

    • Benefits:

  • Full-time opportunity under a service provider (Prestador) contract arrangement.

  • Remote working position based in Brazil.

  • Opportunity to lead technical teams and influence architecture and engineering standards.

  • Exposure to challenging cloud-based projects using .NET and Microsoft Azure.

  • Opportunity to combine hands-on development, technical strategy, and team mentorship.

  • Salary, healthcare coverage, paid leave, and additional benefits are not specified in the original job description.

We are looking for an experienced technology leader who combines hands-on AWS Cloud expertise with a strong passion for developing people and building high-performing teams. In this fully remote role, you will lead a team of cloud architects and specialists, providing mentorship, guidance, and structured career development. You will help strengthen cloud operations, improve technical processes, and introduce AI-driven automation to increase team efficiency. Working closely with business stakeholders and customers, you will translate strategic priorities into reliable, high-quality technical delivery. This position offers significant autonomy, the opportunity to shape a growing technical organization, and the potential to progress into a CTO role in the future.

lists.content:
• Lead and develop a fully remote team of cloud architects and technical specialists, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.

  • Mentor team members, support their technical growth, and help them develop into trusted specialists and future technical leaders.

  • Conduct structured performance feedback, support career development plans, and create an environment built on trust and professional growth.

  • Oversee AWS Cloud architecture, governance, and operational activities, ensuring quality, reliability, and alignment with business needs.

  • Connect organizational strategy with day-to-day team execution, ensuring priorities are clear and technical deliveries meet customer expectations.

  • Structure and continuously improve team processes, identifying bottlenecks and implementing more efficient workflows.

  • Drive automation initiatives, including the adoption of AI-powered solutions to optimize operations and reduce repetitive work.

  • Monitor team performance, delivery progress, and operational processes to maintain service quality and efficiency.

  • Communicate with AWS and participate in technical discussions, forums, and knowledge-sharing activities in an international environment.

    • Requirements

  • Proven experience leading and managing technical teams, with a strong focus on people development, mentoring, structured feedback, and career progression.

  • Practical experience with AWS Cloud, including cloud architecture, governance, and operations.

  • Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to build trust, motivate professionals, and guide distributed teams.

  • Fluency in English for communication with AWS, understanding technical documentation, and participating in global forums. The original listing also specifies intermediate English proficiency, so candidates should be comfortable operating in an international technical environment.

  • Ability to identify process inefficiencies, optimize workflows, and implement automation solutions, including AI-powered tools.

  • Experience coordinating technical activities, monitoring delivery, and aligning team execution with business and customer expectations.

  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, combined with a strategic mindset and a hands-on approach to leadership.

    • Nice to have:

  • AWS certifications, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Developer, or equivalent credentials.

  • Experience working in technology consulting companies or Managed Service Providers (MSPs).

  • Knowledge of FinOps practices or AI applications in business environments.

  • Experience supporting the development of technical teams in fast-growing organizations.

    • Benefits

  • 100% remote working arrangement.

  • Full-time opportunity under a contractor (Pessoa Jurídica – PJ) engagement model.

  • Market-aligned compensation.

  • Collaborative environment built around autonomy, trust, and teamwork.

  • Structured career development plan and opportunities for accelerated professional growth.

  • Potential to progress into a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) position.

  • Opportunity to shape technical operations, develop people, and contribute to a growing technology organization.

  • Emphasis on maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Tech Leader de Engenharia based in Brazil.

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Tech Leader to guide a software engineering team while driving technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. In this role, you will combine hands-on software engineering expertise with people leadership to build and maintain complex, scalable, and high-quality systems. You will play a key role in technical decision-making, solution architecture, and the delivery of new product capabilities. Working primarily with Java-based applications, you will translate business needs into reliable technical solutions while promoting simplicity, collaboration, and engineering best practices. You will also mentor developers, encourage autonomy, and ensure consistent delivery standards across the team. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a collaborative, agile, and remote-friendly environment.

lists.content:
• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and guidance to the engineering team, supporting decision-making, solving complex technical challenges, and ensuring alignment with engineering standards.
  • People Management and Development: Mentor, motivate, and develop engineers through regular one-on-one meetings, individual development plans, constructive feedback, and ongoing performance support.
  • Solution Design and Implementation: Evaluate technical feasibility, plan, design, and implement new functionalities, translating business requirements into scalable and maintainable software solutions.
  • Software Quality and Best Practices: Establish and reinforce engineering standards, development practices, and coding principles to ensure high-quality, reliable, and sustainable solutions.
  • Code Review and Delivery Ownership: Review and approve team contributions, provide actionable feedback, and share responsibility for the quality and consistency of all team deliverables.
  • Project Planning and Execution: Guide developers in breaking down complex initiatives into smaller, cohesive, manageable deliveries that support continuous progress and reduce implementation risks.
  • Architecture and Performance: Contribute to software architecture decisions and ensure systems remain scalable, modular, efficient, and aligned with business needs.
  • Production Monitoring: Monitor solutions in production, assessing errors, performance, availability, and reliability while coordinating improvements when necessary.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Follow industry trends, identify opportunities for innovation, and guide the adoption of technologies and practices that improve engineering capabilities.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Collaborate on the development and improvement of engineering documentation, technical standards, and internal knowledge-sharing resources.

    • Requirements

  • Software Development Experience: Strong professional experience in web development and software engineering, with the ability to contribute to technical discussions and complex implementation decisions.
  • Programming Languages: Solid knowledge of programming languages, frameworks, libraries, and development tools, particularly Java, with familiarity with technologies such as Python, JavaScript, and Ruby.
  • Java Expertise: Genuine interest and willingness to work with Java-based applications and provide technical leadership in a Java-oriented engineering environment.
  • Agile Methodologies: Experience working with Agile development methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.
  • DevOps and Testing: Practical experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), automated testing, and modern software development workflows.
  • Software Architecture: Strong understanding of software architecture principles, design patterns, and best practices for building maintainable applications.
  • Scalable Systems: Knowledge of designing and structuring scalable, modular, high-performance systems.
  • Leadership Skills: Ability to mentor developers, manage conflicts, make informed decisions, and foster a collaborative and accountable team environment.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and align engineering decisions with business objectives.
  • Strategic Thinking: Strong analytical skills, problem-solving abilities, and a strategic mindset focused on long-term technical quality and business impact.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Advanced knowledge of Spring or Grails frameworks.
  • Additional training or certifications in Solution Architecture.
  • Previous experience leading engineering teams in complex software development environments.

    • Benefits

  • Employment Type: Full-time permanent employment under the Brazilian CLT regime.
  • Work Arrangement: Fully remote work, available to professionals across Brazil.
  • Flexible Schedule: 8-hour workday with flexible working arrangements.
  • Professional Growth: Opportunities to develop leadership capabilities and deepen technical expertise.
  • Collaborative Culture: Work in an environment that values teamwork, autonomy, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
  • Technical Impact: Opportunity to influence architectural decisions, engineering standards, and the evolution of complex software systems.
  • Innovation: Exposure to modern technologies and opportunities to contribute to meaningful engineering initiatives.

We are seeking an experienced technology leader to drive Platform Engineering and Developer Experience initiatives, building the foundations for sustainable product growth. In this role, you will lead engineering teams while shaping the technical strategy and improving the tools, processes, and infrastructure that support software delivery. You will oversee the evolution of an Internal Developer Platform, enabling engineering squads to work with greater autonomy and efficiency. You will use engineering metrics and business objectives to guide priorities, improve delivery quality, and accelerate development. You will also foster a high-performance culture built on collaboration, psychological safety, and continuous feedback. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on technical involvement when critical decisions require it. This is a full-time, fully remote opportunity under a Brazilian CLT employment model and is an affirmative-action position for women.

lists.content:
• Lead the Platform Engineering and Developer Experience agenda, establishing the foundations for sustainable product and engineering scalability.

  • Design, build, and continuously improve an Internal Developer Platform (IDP), including self-service capabilities for service creation, environments, templates, and golden paths.

  • Reduce friction throughout the software development lifecycle, including builds, testing, deployment, rollbacks, documentation, and onboarding.

  • Increase engineering team autonomy by improving development workflows, tools, automation, and delivery practices.

  • Define and monitor engineering productivity and delivery quality metrics, including lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and MTTR.

  • Translate engineering metrics and data into actionable improvements and continuous optimization initiatives.

  • Shape the tribe's technical strategy, ensuring engineering decisions align with business priorities and measurable impact.

  • Lead and develop high-performing teams through regular one-on-ones, constructive feedback, career development, and leadership growth.

  • Establish effective team rituals and promote psychological safety, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • Improve delivery speed without compromising quality by advancing testing practices, observability, automation, and engineering standards.

  • Coordinate the resolution of complex technical challenges and reduce the frequency and impact of critical incidents.

  • Prioritize initiatives based on OKRs and KPIs, ensuring technical effort is directed toward the highest-value outcomes.

  • Establish security and compliance guardrails within delivery workflows while preserving engineering speed and efficiency.

  • Participate in software architecture and design decisions, contributing to technical documentation and sustainable engineering standards.

  • Strengthen distributed architecture to ensure scalability, resilience, and a user-centered approach.

    • Requirements:

  • Proven experience leading and managing engineering teams in startups or other fast-paced environments.

  • Track record of working with multidisciplinary teams to build and deliver digital products.

  • Hands-on leadership experience in Platform Engineering and Developer Experience initiatives that have delivered measurable productivity improvements.

  • Strong people management skills, including one-on-ones, career development, feedback practices, and leadership development.

  • Experience improving engineering processes, including Agile methodologies, software development workflows, quality practices, and operations.

  • Ability to define, implement, and manage engineering metrics such as DORA metrics, using data to guide prioritization and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to balance strategic vision with execution, maintaining focus on business impact, quality, and predictable delivery.

  • Strong technical foundation and willingness to take a hands-on approach when necessary to support critical decisions.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to align technical teams and business stakeholders.

    • Nice to have:

  • Previous experience as a technical individual contributor in complex engineering environments.

  • Experience defining and tracking technical OKRs.

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or similar technologies.

  • Experience with containers and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.

  • Experience leading AI-powered productivity initiatives across the software development lifecycle, with responsible adoption practices covering quality, security, cost, and governance.

  • Practical experience using AI to accelerate pull request reviews, test generation and refinement, technical documentation, and incident support.

    • Benefits:

  • Medical insurance through SulAmérica.

  • Dental insurance through Bradesco.

  • Wellhub membership, with coverage available for up to three dependents.

  • 24/7 telemedicine, including online video consultations every day of the week.

  • Zenklub emotional well-being support.

  • Waived monthly fee for one vehicle on the Sem Parar Tag Imparável plan.

  • Flexible food allowance: choose between a grocery-focused meal allowance (VA) or a restaurant-focused meal allowance (VR).

  • Birthday day off, including personal and company birthday celebrations.

  • Pregnancy support program and extended paternity leave.

  • Life insurance.

  • Childcare assistance.

  • Financial assistance for dependents with disabilities.

  • Profit-sharing program (PLR).

  • Fully remote work arrangement.

  • Full-time employment under a Brazilian CLT contract.

You will manage end-to-end recruitment processes, partnering closely with hiring managers to understand technical requirements and deliver qualified candidates. Through proactive sourcing, market research, and structured assessments, you will help build strong talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs. You will also contribute to improving recruitment strategies, monitoring performance indicators, and ensuring an excellent candidate experience. lists.content:

  • Develop and publish targeted job advertisements across specialized recruitment platforms, social media channels, and technology communities.

  • Conduct proactive sourcing and talent hunting through LinkedIn, Gupy, Catho, and other relevant platforms and professional communities.

  • Build and maintain an active talent pool to support recurring and future recruitment needs.

  • Screen technical profiles, conduct structured competency-based interviews, and coordinate technical and behavioral assessments.

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements and present qualified shortlists of 3 to 5 finalists, accompanied by detailed candidate evaluations and recommendations.

  • Ensure a positive candidate experience through transparent communication, timely updates, and structured feedback throughout the recruitment process.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate records and recruitment information within the Gupy applicant tracking system.

  • Conduct salary benchmarking, compensation research, and talent market mapping for technology positions.

  • Monitor recruitment funnel KPIs, prepare monthly performance reports, and recommend improvements to increase hiring efficiency.

  • Support internal communications and employer engagement initiatives, including company announcements, employee engagement campaigns, celebrations, and culture-building activities.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Psychology, Human Resources, or a related field.

  • Proven experience managing end-to-end recruitment processes, particularly for complex and specialized technology positions.

  • Strong knowledge of technical recruitment methodologies, sourcing strategies, and candidate assessment techniques.

  • Hands-on experience using applicant tracking systems (ATS), recruitment platforms, and talent sourcing tools.

  • Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage recruitment workflows, candidate databases, deadlines, and multiple open positions simultaneously.

  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with candidates, hiring managers, and internal stakeholders.

  • Analytical mindset and familiarity with recruitment KPIs, salary benchmarking, and talent market research.

  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven approach, with strong prioritization and problem-solving abilities.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining effective collaboration with different teams.

  • Fully remote working arrangement within Brazil.

  • Temporary PJ (independent contractor) engagement.

  • Fixed-term project covering a maternity leave.

  • Occasional visits to the company's office may be required.

  • Opportunity to work closely with technology leaders and specialized talent acquisition teams.

  • Exposure to diverse and complex technology recruitment projects.

  • Opportunity to contribute to recruitment strategy, employer engagement, and continuous process improvement.

lists.content:

  • Create and maintain clear feature documentation under the guidance of senior product leadership.

  • Monitor the competitive landscape and stay informed about relevant technical developments and market trends within assigned product areas.

  • Coordinate launch readiness across Engineering, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, and Support.

  • Support Product Marketing in preparing customer education materials, release communications, and launch documentation.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Treasury Analyst based in Brazil.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytically strong Treasury Analyst to support global treasury operations within a fast-growing fintech and cryptocurrency environment. In this high-responsibility role, you will oversee daily cash positioning, liquidity management, banking relationships, and financial reconciliations across international operations. Working directly with treasury leadership, you will help maintain accurate financial records, develop reliable cash forecasts, and ensure funds are available to support business needs. You will also analyze financial performance, monitor potential risks, and provide actionable insights to support strategic financial decisions. This position offers exposure to complex global financial operations, including traditional banking infrastructure and cryptocurrency-related activities. It is an excellent opportunity for a proactive finance professional seeking to make a direct impact in a dynamic, technology-driven environment.

lists.content:
As a Treasury Analyst, you will manage and support essential treasury activities, ensuring financial accuracy, effective liquidity management, and compliance across domestic and international operations. You will collaborate with treasury and accounting teams, maintain banking relationships, and deliver financial analysis that supports operational efficiency and informed decision-making.

  • Prepare daily cash positioning reports within the Treasury Management System (TMS) to support global liquidity management.

  • Monitor and reconcile cash-related accounts, including bank accounts, cash held in kiosks, and cash in transit.

  • Perform regular bank reconciliations to ensure transactions are accurately recorded and consistent with accounting records.

  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies and variances across financial accounts.

  • Prepare reconciliation reports and provide supporting documentation to the accounting team during monthly closing processes.

  • Manage banking relationships and administer domestic and international bank accounts.

  • Liaise with financial institutions to obtain bank statements, transaction reports, and updates on cash positions.

  • Monitor fund disbursements and ensure income and expenditure are recorded in accordance with internal procedures and applicable international accounting standards.

  • Maintain accurate and comprehensive treasury records for all financial transactions.

  • Develop and maintain daily, 13-week, and 26-week cash forecasts to ensure sufficient liquidity for operational requirements.

  • Prepare financial models, management reports, and ad hoc analyses covering budget utilization, cash positions, and financial variances.

  • Investigate deviations from financial forecasts, explain discrepancies, and propose preliminary recommendations for management review.

  • Monitor financial activities for unusual transactions or potential compliance concerns, supporting investigations and appropriate reporting.

  • Review budget proposals submitted by other departments and identify technical errors or inconsistencies.

  • Provide detailed financial analysis and explanations regarding account balances and overall treasury performance.

  • Support treasury leadership in financial planning, liquidity decisions, and broader business strategy.

  • Leverage AI-powered tools and automation to improve forecasting, reporting, and daily financial workflows.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate has a strong background in treasury management, accounting, or corporate finance, with hands-on experience managing cash flows, reconciliations, and financial forecasting. You should combine advanced Excel and financial modeling capabilities with practical knowledge of ERP and treasury management systems. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, organization, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently are essential.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • MBA preferred.

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in treasury analysis, treasury management, or a similar financial role.

  • CPA or Certified Management Accountant (CMA) certification is an advantage.

  • Proven experience developing and maintaining financial models and cash flow forecasts.

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite, particularly ERP, general ledger, and financial reporting functions.

  • Experience with FIS Workstation, Kyriba, ION Treasury, or comparable Treasury Management Systems (TMS) for cash positioning, bank connectivity, and liquidity management.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Access or other database management applications.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including:

  • VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, and INDEX-MATCH formulas.

  • Pivot tables for financial reporting and variance analysis.

  • Building and maintaining rolling cash forecasts.

  • Developing reconciliation trackers and financial models from scratch.

  • Familiarity with macros and Power Query for automated and repeatable reporting is an advantage.

  • Strong understanding of cash management, bank reconciliation, liquidity planning, and financial reporting.

  • Knowledge of international accounting standards and financial control procedures.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with strong attention to detail.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments without compromising accuracy.

  • Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of meeting demanding deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Comfortable using AI tools to improve financial forecasting, reporting, and productivity.

  • Basic knowledge of cryptocurrency and blockchain technologies is a plus.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with treasury leadership, accounting teams, and external banking partners.

  • Must currently be based in Latin America (LATAM) or Europe.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive salary in USD, paid consistently on a monthly basis regardless of location.

  • 15 paid vacation days per year.

  • All U.S. federal holidays observed.

  • 100% remote working arrangement.

  • Flexibility to work remotely from eligible locations across Latin America or Europe.

  • Opportunity to work in a fast-growing fintech and cryptocurrency environment.

  • Direct involvement in global treasury operations and high-impact financial decisions.

  • Exposure to international banking relationships, liquidity management, and complex financial systems.

  • Collaborative, high-trust working environment where expertise, initiative, and professional judgment are valued.

  • Opportunity to contribute to financial strategy and operational improvements.

  • Professional growth through exposure to emerging financial technologies and global business operations.

  • Compliance and Quality Control: Incorporate feedback from compliance reviewers, implement revisions, and ensure that all content follows applicable healthcare advertising guidelines and platform policies.

  • Communication Skills: Professional-level English communication skills, both written and verbal, with availability to work during U.S. business hours.

  • Previous experience editing direct-to-consumer (DTC) paid advertisements in healthcare, wellness, supplements, telehealth, or other regulated industries.
  • Experience creating structured advertising variation sets with multiple hooks, opening sequences, and calls to action.

  • Knowledge of Meta, TikTok, and YouTube advertising specifications and policies, particularly for health and wellness content.
  • Experience with audio cleanup, noise reduction, sound leveling, and music ducking.
  • Experience using AI tools responsibly in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments.

  • Advanced color grading and correction skills.
  • Spanish or Tagalog language proficiency for future multilingual content initiatives.
  • Familiarity with AI dubbing and translation tools such as ElevenLabs, HeyGen, or Rask.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Wholesale Manager (E-Commerce & Global Retail) based remotely in Brazil.

In this senior operational leadership role, you will oversee wholesale operations and order management for a growing global consumer business. You will manage and develop distributed teams while ensuring the smooth execution of the entire wholesale order lifecycle, from initial buyer inquiries and order processing to invoicing, payment tracking, and international fulfillment. Acting as the key connection between retail partners, internal departments, finance teams, and global logistics providers, you will ensure seamless coordination across markets and time zones. You will establish scalable processes, strengthen operational accountability, and drive continuous improvements in order accuracy and fulfillment efficiency. With ownership of team performance, operational standards, and buyer satisfaction, you will play a central role in supporting international retail growth. This is an opportunity to shape global wholesale infrastructure in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.

lists.content:
• Wholesale Operations Management: Oversee the complete wholesale and order-capturing lifecycle, ensuring efficient coordination from initial customer inquiries and purchase order processing through invoicing, payment confirmation, and warehouse dispatch.
  • Team Leadership and Development: Manage, mentor, and supervise distributed wholesale and order-capturing teams across different shifts and international time zones. Set daily priorities, allocate responsibilities, conduct regular one-on-one meetings, organize team stand-ups, and support employee onboarding and professional development.
  • Performance Management: Establish and monitor individual and team KPIs, including order accuracy targets above 99%, first-response turnaround times, productivity, attendance, and service-level agreement (SLA) compliance. Identify performance gaps and implement appropriate coaching and workload adjustments.
  • Buyer Relationship Management: Ensure professional, timely, and accurate communication with international B2B retail buyers regarding order status, inventory availability, shipping updates, and account-specific requirements. Handle escalations and resolve complex customer and fulfillment issues.
  • Warehouse and Logistics Coordination: Act as the primary operational contact for global third-party logistics (3PL) providers and warehouse teams. Coordinate inventory allocation, packing, dispatch schedules, and shipment requirements while resolving delivery delays, damaged goods, backorders, and order discrepancies.
  • SOP Development and Process Optimization: Create, document, implement, and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) covering order capture, verification, buyer communication, invoicing, warehouse fulfillment, returns, and claims. Ensure consistent adoption of documented processes across the team.
  • Invoicing and Financial Coordination: Supervise the preparation and organization of commercial invoices, credit notes, and packing lists. Monitor incoming payments, reconcile settlements against purchase orders, and collaborate with bookkeeping and accounting teams to resolve billing discrepancies.
  • Operational Reporting and Governance: Audit workflows, identify process bottlenecks, strengthen documentation standards, and introduce improvements that increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Escalate significant financial or operational irregularities to executive leadership.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in B2B wholesale operations, retail order management, or e-commerce supply chain operations.
  • At least 2–3 years of direct people management experience, including supervising, coaching, and developing remote or geographically distributed teams.
  • Proven experience managing team performance through KPIs, SLAs, productivity monitoring, regular one-on-one meetings, attendance management, and performance improvement initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end wholesale order management, including purchase order processing, order verification, inventory coordination, invoicing, payment tracking, and fulfillment.
  • Hands-on experience working with international warehouses, third-party logistics (3PL) providers, and freight forwarders across multiple geographical locations.
  • Solid knowledge of B2B commercial invoicing, payment terms such as Net 30/60, wire transfers, deposits, credit notes, and financial reconciliation processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to create and maintain scalable SOPs, process documentation, workflow maps, and operational systems.
  • Familiarity with modern collaboration and operational tools such as Lark, Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, and ERP/WMS platforms.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to manage international retail relationships and coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving abilities, with exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to accurate documentation and reliable execution.
  • Comfortable working autonomously in a remote environment, managing multiple priorities, and maintaining operational consistency across different time zones.

    • Benefits:

  • 100% remote flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world within a structured, asynchronous operational environment.
  • Permanent full-time opportunity: Join a growing international business in a senior management position.
  • High-impact leadership: Take direct ownership of wholesale operations, distributed teams, and global order management processes.
  • Operational autonomy: Shape and improve systems, workflows, and infrastructure to support business growth.
  • Global collaboration: Work closely with executive leadership, creative professionals, and experienced operational specialists.
  • Professional development: Gain exposure to international wholesale operations, global retail partnerships, and e-commerce supply chain management.
  • Meaningful responsibility: Play a key role in improving operational performance, customer satisfaction, and business scalability.
